about.title: Hi, I'm Stiven Colorado
paragraphs: I'm a software analyst and developer with solid Full Stack experience, working with technologies such as Python, PHP, JavaScript, TailwindCSS and Node.js.

I have implemented clean architectures such as Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Hexagonal, organizing projects into domains, controllers, repositories, services and adapters to keep them maintainable and scalable.
I have experience building RESTful APIs with JWT and CORS, and advanced Django setups with MySQL databases and file storage both locally and in the cloud (S3).
On the frontend, I work with ReactJS and React Native, using Redux/MobX for state management, building custom hooks to centralize HTTP requests and polishing the user experience.
